title: HPCG Supercomputer Performance: November 2026
desc: The top ten systems in the November 2026 High-Performance Conjugate Gradient (HPCG) list. This benchmark emphasizes memory access and communication behavior and differs from HPL. Coverage is limited to submitted HPCG results, not every supercomputer worldwide.

source.name: TOP500 — HPCG November 2026 list
source.note: On 24 November 2026 (Korea time), the AllRanks assistant (Codex) checked places 1–10, system names, countries and HPCG (TFlop/s) values against the official November 2026 table and compared the tenth and eleventh results. The ranking covers systems with a submitted HPCG result. JUPITER Booster did not submit an HPCG result for this edition.
